concerns.text: Task T005 (and T005’s description) introduces a fallback to Leave-One-Out Cross‑Validation when n < 50. This weakens FR‑005, which explicitly requires 5‑fold cross‑validation, and also violates Constitution VI (Cross‑Validation Integrity) that mandates 5‑fold CV for within‑stress evaluation.

Task T010 adds edge‑case unit tests but provides no concrete verification artifact (e.g., a CV‑integrity report) to demonstrate SC‑005’s “absence of circular data dependencies”. The acceptance criterion for SC‑005 is therefore dropped.
